notes.title: Important Notice
notes.content:
Dear players, thanks for your support of Ling all the time. 
Due to the change of the publisher, Ling will be temporarily removed from Steam Store and will be put back later with awesome new features. If you have already purchased the game, please join our official QQ group: 933794804. We will inform you of the new version and as a compensation we will send you new keys..
If you have any question, please contact us freely. 
We are sorry for the inconvenience and thanks for your understanding.

notes.title: Update from v1.0.0.0 to v1.0.4.2
notes.content:
[h1] v1.0.1.0[/h1]
Fix in very low frame rate or hitching, map loading issue.

[h1] v1.0.2.0[/h1]
+Max+ and Max++ in graphics.
Max+ and Max++ both use the highest resolution that your main display can handle.
And Max+ will lower some settings to give better fps and Max++ just max everything.
They will not show up if your display is 1080p or lower.
In our test, GTX 1070 can do 4k 60fps in Max+.
Currently we don't support window mode.

+Show current resolution in UI.
+Fix some sfxs and lower some particle effects.
+Some mesh and texture fix.

+In UI you can press Escape again to enter the menu and use arrow keys to select items. (Or special right button on controller 'start button')
+Change some pause cameras.

[h1] v1.0.2.1[/h1]
+Adjust pause cameras.
+Lower some sfxs.
+Lower boss music.
+Fix mesh.
+Reduce dash camera shake.

[h1] v1.0.3.0[/h1]
+Lower some sfxs.
+Auto switch to beginner, if you die too many times at beginning.
+Auto heal in beginner mode when under 1/3 HP.
+Fix in High or above graphics' resolutions, if your display is lower than 1080p.

+Fix some full screen issue.
+Adjust first punch particle fx.
+Lower Boss dash camera shake again.

+Lower the difficulty a bit in first temple, let player focus on learning one thing.
+Fix some sfx locations.
+Better keyboard/controller UI operating.

[h1] v1.0.4.0[/h1]
+Windowed mode.
+Fix some sfx issue.
+Fix HP Item spawn locations and launch angles.
+Fix a mesh.
+Fix Boss animation loop.
+Lower the post process effect in snow stage(that noise effect).
+Lower the reaction force when hit wall or ground.

[h1] v1.0.4.1[/h1]
+Fix in some case, player enter the game with lower resolution in Windows and higher resolution in game in fullscreen, can not click UI buttons issue.
+Reduce gamepad force feedback.
+Lower dash sfx.
+Pause now opens menu directly.

[h1] v1.0.4.2[/h1]
+Fix collision of floor that in front of temple.
+Fix spawn point before Xing Tian Boss.
+Fix collision around the exit of ancient temple.
+Gamepad vibration switch in menu.

If you have green screen, please change to windowed mode.
If you have crashed, please try to close background apps.

notes.title: Little advice to prevent game crash
notes.content:
We ran into a game crash on our lowest end test machine.

Problem machine setup is
AMD Athlon II X3 435 [spoiler]6USD[/spoiler]
2G DDR3 [spoiler]8USD[/spoiler]
HD 7770 1GB [spoiler]24USD[/spoiler]

After analyzing .dmp files, We found an error stopping on an Unreal Engine known bug which is not fixed. [url=https://issues.unrealengine.com/issue/UE-52917] bug[/url]
This bug is out of our capability. So we can only hope Epic would fix it in the next version.

We have never crash on the remaining five test machines, we have a continuous automatic test on each machine works stably more than 20 hours during a single walk through, the other two has been testing the game for two weeks  without error and shut down .

For this problem machine, we have to increase the memory, replace the graphics card and other attempts, but the crash still exists, until  replaced a AMD Athlon II X4 635 CPU [spoiler]23USD[/spoiler], the crash no longer occur.

Based on the analysis of the .dmp file and the actual replacement parts, we guess the game crash mainly occurs on the CPU core / under-computing issue.

Unfortunately for the players encountered crashes, we apologize for your negative experience, we have tried our best to minimize the problem probability, given the lack of human and financial resources, the result is far from perfect,.If you are still willing to try, we recommend to first confirm the computer's CPU has at least 4 logical cores, then try to close the background CPU resources, such as some system guard software, some downloading software, automatic backup or disk scanning,.If you are using laptop, please make sure the cooling is effective, CPU frequency is not lowered by high temperature, then start the game.

The picture shows our test machine
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31708348/a5312d90d23678a9bf127c5a54964e0693d72084.jpg[/img]


Finally, we also tested the game on the i3 7100 notebook computer and the i5 4200u notebook, and the image quality was low but no crash.
Therefore, we think that computers configured in recent years should be able to run our game stably if properly configured.

We hope this can help some of those players  who has encountered the crash,and play our game normaly.
